scoring_justification: Full exact diagonalization recompute is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; therefore the energy is compared to the paper’s reported gold with tolerance, and the CSV is structurally audited for shape and characteristic peak.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold energy value for the spin-magnetograviton
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper conclusion: "the numerical value (1.57 meV) obtained in computer modeling of the finite electron system of 10 electrons"
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text; no transformation needed
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Direct paper-reported quantity from the cited prior modeling [13].

schema.description: A single line containing a floating-point number representing the zero-momentum spin-magnetograviton energy in meV.

outputs.description: The computed spin-magnetograviton energy, to be compared with a hidden reference value within a predefined tolerance.

Difference between the pair correlation functions of the excited (spin-magnetograviton) and ground states. The structural audit verifies row count, numeric columns, and the existence of a characteristic peak in Δg(r) within a specified r-range.

output_contract.notes: The energy file is compared to a hidden gold value within an absolute tolerance; the CSV is checked for consistency (≥100 rows, numeric columns, peak location). No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
